name: Serving Others
overview: Serving others is a Christ-centered calling demonstrated by Jesus Himself, who came not to be served but to serve and give His life for many, setting the ultimate example of humility and sacrificial love. Scripture teaches that those who generously care for others, such as feeding the hungry and welcoming strangers, reflect God’s heart and bring glory to the Father. The blessings of a generous spirit are assured, as one who gives will also be blessed in return, and true greatness is found in being a servant to others.
